evidence: Built the criterion->public-requirement map for all 2 gate, 39 functional, 5 polish and 5 visual criteria. Every graded demand traces to instruction.md, hireops_rules.md or a professional default; none requires an exact label, route, selector, field name, layout or reference-only rule (app_context.md:33-34 and functional/prompt.md:15 'Do not require routes, selectors, field names, layouts or exact wording'; visual/prompt.md:14 'Layout, labels and styles are the implementer's choice... No phone layout or theme switching is required', matching instruction.md:11). Map highlights: hro_job_open (places 0/51/2.5, non-manager HM) <- rules.md:44-46 'whole number from 1 to 50', 'chosen from the hiring-manager accounts'; hro_add_email_rules <- rules.md:49-52; hro_move_one_stage/hro_reject_hired/hro_reopen/hro_reject_reason <- rules.md:64-70; hro_arrive_bottom/hro_reorder <- rules.md:74-76; hro_interview_* and hro_undo_full <- rules.md:80-82,115-116; hro_refused_put_back (reason + focus on that card's controls) <- rules.md:101-102 and instruction.md:3, and the criterion explicitly accepts a pre-send UI refusal; hro_mgr_* <- rules.md:86-90; hro_observer_readonly/hro_candidate_no_staff/hro_anonymous/hro_refusal_status (401/403/404/409) <- rules.md:38-40,94-96; hro_stale_refused 'by whom' <- instruction.md:3, rules.md:95-96 (accepts name or an identifier mapped through staff data); hro_bulk_* (board order A2,V and Y,W,X) <- rules.md:106-109; hro_undo_* (re-order/reject by others blocks; note and other-card change do not; once only) <- rules.md:113-117; hro_activity (newest first, per-job filter, reason on rejection, undo/reorder lines) <- rules.md:127-130, with lenient one-line-per-multi-move allowance; hro_live_board/hro_msg_exchange/hro_unread_counts/hro_seen live within 15 s <- instruction.md:5, rules.md:134-136; hro_msg_compose (<b> literal, Enter/Shift+Enter, empty+focused box, no reappearance) <- rules.md:155-157,192; hro_thread_latest/earlier (30, remaining count) <- rules.md:161-164 and seed thread_page_size 30; hro_unread_scrolled_up 'told how many' <- rules.md:176-177; hro_seen incl. Observer never counts and candidate-side seen <- rules.md:181-183; hro_drafts/hro_pol_session_resume (per person/conversation/browser, survives sign-out and another user's visit, unsaved note private) <- instruction.md:7, rules.md:122-123,187-192; hro_candidate_view wording table <- rules.md:200-207; hro_candidate_private (no notes/reason/rejected-from/position/others/activity in any response) <- instruction.md:9, rules.md:209-211; hro_pol_live_board/live_thread/earlier_place <- instruction.md:5,7, rules.md:138-140,163-164,175; hro_pol_failed_send 'stays in the box... told it was not sent' <- rules.md:156-157 (local not-sent marker allowed); hro_restart <- instruction.md:15, rules.md:223-226. Seed facts asserted by criteria verified in seed_data.json: Platform Engineer Applied=Greta Lindqvist, Ade Bello, Marco Rossi and Screen=Priya Nair, Samuel Ortiz by position; Noor's note text 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.' (seed line 1024); Lena read_count 2 of 3 messages with the third by Farah => 1 unread; APP-101 has 120 messages. Sign-in criteria (gate render, candidate sign-in) are the documented known false positive and in any case the instruction asks for sign-in (instruction.md:7,9,17). Hiding/omitting refused controls is explicitly the app's choice (functional/prompt.md:23; hro_move_one_stage, hro_reject_hired, hro_mgr_other_job, hro_observer_readonly, hro_undo_once). Conforming alternatives tried mentally: drag+buttons app, SSE vs polling, drafts in localStorage keyed by user vs server, single Activity line per multi-move, disabled-with-tooltip full Interview target, candidate 403 vs 404 for another's card: all pass the criteria as written. Plausible broken apps (e.g., client-only refusals, from-stage instead of version concurrency, drafts shared across users) are failed by public rules, not by unrequired demands. Residual low-risk observations, not defects: (a) hro_stale_refused is exercised by a page.evaluate replay, so in practice the identity must arrive in the 409 response or already be on screen; an app that only discovers 'who' by a client-side follow-up read after a UI 409 could be missed, but the public rule requires the person be told and the response route is the natural design (P3, latent). (b) hro_refused_put_back gives no 'hiding is optional' clause; an app that silently hides the Interview target when full would show no reason, which conflicts with instruction.md:3 'tell me why', so this is a public requirement rather than a hidden one. (c) hro_add_candidate/hro_job_open require email/source/team/manager/places only 'wherever the app shows' details or by behaviour; professional default.
